recipes.name: Skillet Apple Crisp

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli

recipes.name: Spicy Peanut Chicken Noodles

recipes.name: Quick Yogurt Naan
recipes.subtitle: Skillet naan from a Greek-yogurt dough, brushed with garlic butter
recipes.ing: 1½ cups bread or all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling · 2 tsp baking powder · ½ tsp kosher salt · 1¼ cups plain nonfat Greek yogurt · 2 tsp olive oil · 1 Tbsp butter or ghee · 1 clove garlic · Flaky salt (optional)

recipes.name: Japanese Ground-Meat Curry (Kīma Karē)
recipes.subtitle: Turkey and beef curry with carrots, potatoes and peas, thickened with curry roux, over calrose rice
recipes.ing: 1 cup calrose rice · 2 onions · 1 lb baby carrots · 1 lb potatoes · 1½ cups frozen peas · 4 cloves garlic · 1 Tbsp grated fresh ginger · 1.7 lb ground turkey · 1 lb ground beef, 93/7 · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · ½ tsp kosher salt · 2½ cups water · About 4 oz Japanese curry roux (about half a 7–8 oz box) · 1 Tbsp ketchup · 1 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce

recipes.name: Gouda Chickpea Pasta with Chicken

recipes.ing: 10 oz chickpea pasta · 1 Tbsp kosher salt, for the water · 1¼ lb chicken tenderloins · ½ tsp kosher salt · ¼ tsp black pepper · 1 Tbsp olive oil · 1 × 12 oz can fat-free evaporated milk · 1 Tbsp cornstarch · 3 cloves garlic · 1 tsp Dijon mustard · ¼ tsp black pepper · 2 oz Colby Jack or Monterey Jack · 2 oz aged gouda · 1 oz aged gouda · 2 salad kits (about 12 oz each)

recipes.name: Creamy Gochujang Noodles with Crispy Beef

recipes.ing: 1¼ cups low-fat cottage cheese · 5 Tbsp gochujang (105 g) · 5 Tbsp water · 1½ lb 96% lean ground beef · 1 tsp neutral oil · 2½ Tbsp maple syrup · 1½ Tbsp low-sodium soy sauce · 1 Tbsp rice vinegar · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 2 cloves garlic · 5 scallions, whites and greens separated · 12½ oz dried wheat noodles (knife-cut, lo mein or udon; 360 g) · 1 lb broccoli florets · 1 cup frozen shelled edamame · 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds

recipes.name: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken Noodles
recipes.subtitle: Crispy ground chicken in a sticky honey, garlic, chili and black vinegar glaze, tossed with noodles and seared cabbage slaw
recipes.ing: 5 Tbsp honey · 3 Tbsp chili garlic sauce (or sriracha) · 3 Tbsp low-sodium soy sauce · 3 Tbsp Chinese black vinegar (or balsamic) · 1 Tbsp grated fresh ginger · 6 cloves garlic · ⅓ cup water · 1 × 14 oz bag coleslaw mix (about 8 cups) · 3 tsp olive oil, divided · 2 lb ground chicken breast · 5 scallions, greens sliced · 12 oz dried wheat noodles (knife-cut, lo mein or udon; 340 g) · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds

Balsamic works but tastes sweeter and fruitier.

recipes.name: Thai-Style Basil Chicken

recipes.name: Cottage Pie

recipes.ing: 3 cups rolled oats · 1 cup slivered or chopped almonds · 1 cup cashews · ¾ cup shredded sweet coconut · ¼ cup + 2 Tbsp dark brown sugar · ¼ cup + 2 Tbsp maple syrup · ¼ cup vegetable oil · ¾ tsp salt · 1 cup dried fruit
recipes.notes: You can fit 2 recipes in one sheet pan, although you may opt for a deeper pan so it’s easier to turn.

recipes.name: Granola #2
recipes.ing: 3 cups oats · 1 cup chopped almonds · ½ cup sunflower seed · ½ cup pumpkin seed (or other nut, such as pecan) · ½ Tbsp wheat germ (if you have it) · ½ Tbsp cinnamon · ¼ tsp salt · 2 Tbsp oil or butter · ½ cup sugar (honey, syrup, or brown sugar) · 1 cup dried fruit

recipes.name: Horseradish and Cranberry Sauce
recipes.subtitle: From Greta (and Susan Stamberg’s)
recipes.ing: 2 cups whole raw cranberries, washed · 1 small onion · ¾ cup sour cream · ½ cup sugar · 2 Tbsp horseradish from a jar
recipes.notes: The relish will be thick, creamy and shocking pink (“OK, Pepto Bismol pink.”).

recipes.name: Hot Chocolate
recipes.subtitle: Served at Eliza’s Open House
recipes.ing: 3 cups whole milk · 1 cup half and half · ¼ Dutch cocoa · ½ cup sugar · ¼ tsp cinnamon · ¼ tsp vanilla

recipes.name: Keto Quiche
recipes.ing: ½ cup butter, melted · 1½ cups almond flour · ⅓ coconut flour (if needed, and especially for a sweet pie, blend coconut as a substitute) · ½ tsp salt · 1 beaten egg · 6 slices thick-cut bacon, cut in pieces · 1 medium onion · 8 ounces chopped fresh spinach (or if using frozen, thaw and squeeze to remove moisture) · ½ cup heavy whipping cream · 4 eggs · ¼ tsp salt · ⅙ tsp pepper · 1 cup cheese of choice, grated

recipes.name: Mojo Sauce
recipes.subtitle: From Greta
recipes.ing: 12 cloves raw mashed garlic · Cayenne pepper, to taste · 1 tsp kosher salt · 4 tsp ground cumin · 1 cup olive oil · ⅓ cup orange juice concentrate · ⅓ cup lime juice · ¼ cup brown sugar · 1½ Tbsp sherry vinegar
recipes.notes: Another divine Greta contribution, discovered in 2025 by Mom. Great as a marinade/sauce for grilled chicken. Also good on pork or beef, or over rice, or with a cucumber and tomato salad, or with leftover chicken for chicken salad. This is YUMMY! Sherry vinegar is worth buying and keeping around.

recipes.name: Passionfruit Curd
recipes.ing: ¾ cup passionfruit pulp · 2 whole eggs · 2 egg yolks · ½ cup sugar · ½ stick butter
recipes.notes: May freeze.

recipes.name: Raspberry Pretzel “Salad”
recipes.subtitle: Introduced by Chloe
recipes.ing: 3 cups tiny pretzel twists, crushed · ¼ sugar · 8 Tbsp melted butter · 16 ounces cream cheese, softened · 1 cup sugar · 1 tsp vanilla · 8 ounces frozen whipped topping, thawed · 6 ounces raspberry jello · 1 cup boiling water · 1 cup very cold water or water and ice cubes · 16 ounces frozen raspberries
recipes.notes: A favorite for celebratory meals. Always requested by Mark.

recipes.name: Rose’s Mix
recipes.subtitle: Not to eat. From Rose
recipes.ing: 1 quart ammonia (non-sudsing) · 1 quart isopropyl alcohol · 2 quarts water
recipes.notes: Mom’s favorite cleaning solution.
